answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Hadith & Sunnah Question ID: 151030 Country: INDIA Title: I hope you are doing well. What is method of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) to use Atar? How he used to apply atar? Please let me know. Question: I hope you are doing well. What is method of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) to use Atar? How he used to apply atar? Please let me know. Answer ID: 151030 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1145/1146/L=9/1438) It is sunnah to apply atar. The Holy Prophet Muhammad (may peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) liked it too much. But we do not know the way how he used to apply it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
